R188.note: text().bindparams() with a named placeholder is the correct SQLAlchemy parameterization API; return shape and function signature unchanged.

R195.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, param) is the standard fix; same INSERT semantics preserved.

R206.note: sanitizer.sanitize(SecurityContext.HTML, ...) is Angular's correct sanitizing API and satisfies the stated contract; primary snippet omits the SecurityContext import but the write-up gives a working numeric fallback.
